GKOS.headline: West Pharma Q3 Earnings Rise on HVP Strength, 2026 Outlook Raised
GKOS.description: West Pharmaceutical Services (WST) reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $2.66, up 35.7% year-over-year and beating consensus by 22%. Revenues reached $874.5 million with 11.9% organic growth, driven by strong HVP Components sales. The company raised its full-year 2026 guidance for revenue and adjusted EPS, reflecting confidence in continued momentum.

GKOS.headline: Glaukos (GKOS) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
GKOS.description: Glaukos (GKOS) reported quarterly earnings of $0.47 per share, significantly beating the consensus estimate of a loss of $0.12 per share, with a 491.67% earnings surprise. The company posted revenues of $211.03 million, surpassing estimates by 24.99% and up 58% year-over-year. The stock has gained 60.5% year-to-date and holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating, though the Medical-Instruments industry ranks in the bottom 40% of Zacks industries.

GKOS.headline: Compared to Estimates, Glaukos (GKOS) Q3 Earnings: A Look at Key Metrics
GKOS.description: Glaukos reported Q3 2026 revenue of $211.03 million, up 58% year-over-year and beating consensus estimates by 25%. EPS came in at $0.47 versus expectations of -$0.12, representing a 492% surprise. Strong performance was driven by U.S. Glaucoma revenue (+72.4%) and exceptional Corneal Health revenue growth (+172.3% in U.S., +153.4% overall). The stock has a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating.

GKOS.headline: SYK Q3 Earnings: Can Recovery Momentum Offset Operational Headwinds?
GKOS.description: Stryker (SYK) is expected to report Q3 2026 earnings on October 29 with EPS growth of 11.6% to $3.56 and revenue growth of 8.6% to $6.58 billion, supported by strong hospital equipment demand and Mako robotic adoption. However, the stock faces headwinds from peripheral vascular supply disruptions, cybersecurity remediation costs, and margin pressures. The company carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) with a negative Earnings ESP of -1.04%, suggesting limited upside potential.

GKOS.headline: ProDex Q1 Earnings Preview: Can Strong Sales Momentum Sustain Growth?
GKOS.description: ProDex is expected to report Q1 fiscal 2027 earnings with consensus estimates of 67 cents per share (8.1% YoY growth) and $20.4M in revenues (10.1% increase). While the company showed strong Q4 results with 17% sales growth and improved 35% gross margins, investors will focus on sustainability amid high customer concentration (78% from largest customer), declining backlog, and risks from the recent Advanced Precision Machining acquisition integration.

ADT.headline: Stock Market Today, Oct. 29: ADT Surges 33% on $10 Per Share All-Cash Acquisition Deal
ADT.description: ADT surged 33% after its board unanimously approved an all-cash acquisition by private equity firm Thrive Holdings at $10 per share, representing a 50% premium over its 30-day average. The deal is expected to close in early 2027, with the stock now trading just 1% below the acquisition price, indicating market confidence in the transaction's completion.

ADT.headline: On National First Responders Day, ADT Honors Those Who Answer the Call and Unveils Renovated North Texas Monitoring Center
ADT.description: ADT celebrated National First Responders Day by unveiling a newly renovated monitoring center in Irving, Texas, following a $2 million investment in the facility. The company honored nine monitoring professionals and local first responders, announcing $30,000 in donations to support first responder organizations including the Irving Police Athletic League and Grey Matters to Firefighters.

CROX.headline: GDP, PCE, Jobless Claims and Q3 Earnings - Busy Morning!
CROX.description: Pre-market futures showed early weakness but recovered slightly following a better-than-expected Q3 GDP report of 3.4%. PCE inflation came in slightly below expectations at 3.6% year-over-year, while jobless claims remained near historic lows at 194K. Mixed earnings results emerged with LLY and MA beating expectations, CROX surging on strong results, but CAT declining after failing to raise guidance despite beating earnings.

PURR.headline: Stock Market Today, Oct. 29: Hyperliquid Strategies Stock Surges 23% as Wall Street Giant and Billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller Back Hyperliquid
PURR.description: Hyperliquid Strategies (PURR) surged 23% on October 29, 2026, following two major announcements: Intercontinental Exchange partnered with Trade[XYZ] to bring regulated perpetual futures markets to the U.S. using Hyperliquid's infrastructure, and billionaire investor Stanley Druckenmiller disclosed an investment in Trade[XYZ]. Trading volume reached 202% above its three-month average, reflecting heightened investor interest, though analysts caution that long-term performance depends on HYPE token

FTAI.headline: FTAI Aviation (FTAI) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
FTAI.description: FTAI Aviation reported Q3 2026 earnings of $1.43 per share, beating consensus estimates of $1.31, with revenues of $977.66 million slightly exceeding expectations. However, the stock has underperformed the S&P 500 by 28.2 percentage points year-to-date. The company received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.

GEN.headline: GEN Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Financial Wellness Strength
GEN.description: Gen Digital (GEN) reported Q2 fiscal 2027 non-GAAP EPS of 74 cents, beating estimates by 2.78%, with revenues of $1.37 billion up 12% YoY. The company achieved its sixth consecutive quarter of double-digit bookings growth at $1.347 billion. Trust-Based Solutions surged 26% to $511 million while Cyber Safety maintained record 62% operating margins. GEN.headline: Gen Digital: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
GEN.description: Gen Digital reported 12% revenue growth to $1.37 billion in Q2 FY2027, with partner channel revenue surging 40% to $295 million. The company is leveraging AI automation to reduce costs across engineering and customer support, while generating nearly $2 billion in annual free cash flow. Management prioritizes organic growth over transformative acquisitions, positioning the company for sustainable long-term earnings expansion.

CVNA.headline: Compared to Estimates, Carvana (CVNA) Q3 Earnings: A Look at Key Metrics
CVNA.description: Carvana reported Q3 2026 revenue of $8.04 billion, beating estimates by 4.87%, but EPS of $0.39 missed consensus expectations of $0.47 by 17.02%. While retail vehicle sales and per-unit gross profits exceeded analyst estimates, wholesale gross profit per unit fell short. The stock has underperformed the S&P 500 over the past month and carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating.
